biggest_catch: Friend must maintain a qualifying daily average balance for 60 days after account opening ($500+ checking/savings; $5,000+ money market; business $2,000+).
catches: Referrer receives a $75 Visa Virtual Reward per qualifying referral; the person referred also earns $75.
Earn up to $600 per year; one-year period runs January 1 through December 31.

Personal: referral registers, opens new BayFirst personal checking or savings, and has a daily average balance of $500+ after 60 days; personal money market requires $5,000+ average balance after 60 days.

Business: referral opens new BayFirst business checking with $2,000+ daily average balance after 60 days, or business money market with $15,000+ after 60 days; business accounts must be opened at a BayFirst banking center.
Minimum amount to open ranges from $50 to $100 depending on product.
Reward payments sent 2-3 weeks after all offer requirements are completed.
